evals.prompt: Create a distinctive Next.js landing page for a premium repair service. I like editorial layouts, warm neutrals, and restrained motion; avoid generic SaaS gradients. Do not do market research.
evals.expected_output: Standalone preference-led concept funnel and local Next.js build without research.

evals.prompt: Use the approved brand and customer segment to build a unique responsive marketing site. Generate a small hero-image contact sheet with FAL only after showing the estimated cost, then prepare a GitHub/Vercel Preview.
evals.expected_output: Uses approved brand constraints, approval-gated FAL build-time assets, responsive QA, and Preview workflow.

evals.prompt: Run a simple A/B test on the homepage hero CTA. Keep the design unchanged except for the CTA copy.
evals.expected_output: Declares one hypothesis/variable/metric, uses server-evaluated control-treatment flags with a control fallback and FlagValues, and keeps production activation gated.

evals.prompt: Build the homepage so it radiates confidence. Use a subtle amount of superlative language—enough to feel compelling, never inflated—and support it with proof.
evals.expected_output: Uses decisive, specific copy and hierarchy; applies at most a small number of earned superlatives, avoids unsupported rankings or guarantees, and places proof near the CTA.

evals.prompt: Repair slow Next.js pages and missing metadata, preserve the current design.
evals.expected_output: Maintenance baseline, full route inventory, browser and Lighthouse evidence, no creative restart.

evals.prompt: Launch an EU site without analytics. Branding already has the favicon set.
evals.expected_output: Analytics not_requested with user choice and absence evidence; favicon handoff integration; consent controls remain reviewed.

evals.prompt: Prepare optional PostHog A/B testing and GA4 plus Meta campaign tracking. Do not connect accounts yet.
evals.expected_output: Separate optional choices and consent purposes, one assignment authority, deduplicated exposure/conversions, draft account mapping and tests without activation.

evals.prompt: Run an AEO/GEO visibility audit of our existing marketing site and tell me what to fix first.
evals.expected_output: Existing-site audit loads maintenance path plus aeo-geo-visibility procedure; bottleneck and measurement limits stated; no citation guarantees; owner actions surfaced via contract.

evals.prompt: Audit an existing B2B translation website. Pricing varies by language and length. The quote request is readable. We have no analytics.
evals.expected_output: Preserve quote pricing and scope. Inspect real evidence; no mandatory Product/Offer schema, fixed price or new instrumentation; unknown metrics remain unknown and no change is valid.

evals.prompt: Rewrite exactly these two garden-maintenance headings: Our Services; Contact. No claims or other deliverables.
evals.expected_output: Return exactly two replacement headings; no visibility panel, research workspace or recurring owner program.

evals.prompt: Product page shows EUR29; approved inventory says EUR35; last feed export is stale. Prepare local fixes only.
evals.expected_output: Bind product/variant to current authority, correct draft visible price and applicable markup, prepare fresh export only if freshness established. No publication, stale feed or redundant approval of already approved price.

evals.prompt: Build a new website. I have not provided design references or photos.
evals.expected_output: Ask once for a small set of admired sites with reasons and offer supplied photos for direct use or AI guidance. Record none/delegated and continue if the user has no examples. Do not start business research.

evals.prompt: Build a new site using these two supplied reference URLs and my attached photo set. Photo A is for direct use; B and C should guide AI imagery. Do not ask me for references again.
evals.expected_output: Inspect the supplied sites/photos, record actual style observations, preserve the per-photo modes, produce an original direction, use native imagegen when available and trace generated outputs to the references actually used. Do not upload A as an AI reference.

evals.prompt: Fix only a broken navigation link. Keep the current design and images.
evals.expected_output: Repair the link without asking for inspiration sites, photos or a new design direction.

evals.prompt: I just deployed the website to production at https://www.example.com; the apex domain redirects to www and I also own example.org. Is the SEO side done?
evals.expected_output: Run or request the production host probe (robots, sitemap, canonical and og:url on the production host with 200 and no redirect; a recorded decision for example.org), report its warnings, and write the owner-only Search Console/Bing onboarding steps into owner-actions with search_console recorded as owner_handoff. Do not claim the site is indexed.

evals.prompt: Run an AI citability audit on https://www.example.com and tell us what to fix so ChatGPT and Google AI Mode cite us.
evals.expected_output: geo-audit mode: Runs or attempts the pinned geo audit wrapper on the public URL and reports blocking access/indexing issues before content and entity items. Lists llms.txt and JSON-LD only as hygiene with the Google guide and Ahrefs study as evidence. Does not promise citations or rankings and does not apply fixes. Reports tool_unavailable honestly if the CLI is missing.

evals.prompt: Audit our local Next.js build in ./out for GEO before deploying.
evals.expected_output: geo-audit mode: Explains that the upstream tool audits public URLs only and asks for a deployed preview URL or production URL; does not fabricate a score for the local directory.
